subject: Skyward AI marketplace inquiry — intro + demo coordination
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@skyward.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: product@skyward.ai
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Marketplace trial -> interested in a short intro/demo

Hi Rachel,

We signed up via the Cloud Marketplace this morning and spun up a small test instance to evaluate inference for a feature were prototyping (embedding-based search + summarization). The trial went well — we saw promising latency numbers but have a couple of questions around: VPC deployment options, data retention, and how model rollouts are handled without disrupting production traffic.

Would love to schedule a quick 30-minute intro/demo with someone who can walk through Dedicated vs Private options and give a sense of cost tradeoffs. Our product lead James O'Leary (cc'd) will join. We are on Pacific time.

Attachments: trial-logs-summary.txt (attachment), sample_request.json (attachment)

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Senior Product Manager — Skyward AI
elena.ortiz@skyward.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@skyward.ai>
Cc: James O'Leary <james.oleary@skyward.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace trial -> interested in a short intro/demo

Hi Elena — great to hear you got the trial running, welcome and thanks for the details. I can take a first pass and sync in our AE to cover pricing and architecture.

Quick options for a 30-min intro (all PST):
- Mon 11/29 10:00–10:30
- Mon 11/29 15:00–15:30
- Tue 11/30 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, happy to send a Calendly link. Agenda suggestion: 1) short product walkthrough focused on Dedicated vs Private, 2) review your trial logs / latency profile, 3) next steps & high-level pricing.

I took a quick look at the trial logs you attached — can you also share the workload profile (QPS, typical sequence length) if you have it handy? That will help our AE come prepared with cost estimates.

I've cc'd Vivek Kulkarni (AE) who can join the demo.

Best,
Rachel Kim
SDR, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood_one-pager.pdf (company one-pager)

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@skyward.ai>

Cc: James O'Leary <james.oleary@skyward.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace trial -> interested in a short intro/demo

Thanks Rachel — Mon 11/29 10:00 PST works for James and me. Our workload is roughly 12 QPS at peak for search requests, average sequence length ~120 tokens, and a small batch of long summaries (~600 tokens) at lower frequency. I attached a zipped file with a sanitized sample of the trial logs (skyward_trial_logs.zip) and a one-page note on our compliance needs.

A couple of asks for the call:
- Can someone touch on how rollouts work (canary vs blue/green) and options to pin a model?
- High-level expected latency for Dedicated vs Private for both small (2–5 QPS) and your stated ~12 QPS profile.

If you can send a calendar invite, we'll accept.

I'll cover Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs and provide latency ballparks for the workload you described (2–5 QPS and ~12 QPS peaks) and outline rollout options (canary + automatic fallback). I can also show a quick batching/cache config that typically reduces per-token costs by ~20% for medium-length sequences.

Prep items for the call (optional but helpful):
- A sample request/response or a sanitized trace from your trial (you mentioned sample_request.json)
- Any security/compliance checklist items we should be aware of (KMS/HSM, retention windows)
